about: Hand-labeled job-matching evaluation set. Labels were written from each listing's text and each persona's stated inputs BEFORE the matcher was implemented, and must not be edited to fit matcher output. suitable = every persona requirement is confirmed by the listing; unknown = no confirmed conflict, but at least one persona requirement cannot be determined from the listing (must only appear flagged as uncertain); unsuitable = wrong occupation or at least one confirmed conflict. Any listing not labeled for a persona is unsuitable for that persona (different occupation). Today is taken as 2026-09-27.
